 Order

This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 09.12.2021 passed by Member in Claim Case No.MACC/103/2019 for enhancement of Rs.11,000/-.
2. Only quantum of compensation is involved in this appeal, accordingly, the facts are being stated briefly.
In an application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, a compensation of Rs.2,23,200/- was awarded for the physical injuries caused on 08.01.2019 at 06:00 pm in a motor vehicular accident.

3. The tribunal awarded a compensation in the following heads which is as follows:-
Physical pain & Mental suffering Rs.25,000/-

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6524 2 MA-637-2022 Medical expenses Rs.15,000/-
Transportation, Attender & Special Diet Rs.5,000/-
 Loss of income Rs.1,78

sentences.text: 4. The award was passed assessing the permanent physical disability as 15% and income per month as Rs.7,000/-.
The age of the appellant was 36 years.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
5. The tribunal ought to have assessed the per month income as Rs.7,000/- and 40% ought to have added for future prospect.

The tribunal had no reason to lower the disability from 20% to 15% as Dr.
Dinesh Thakur has assessed the 20% permanent physical disability in relation to the whole body in para 5 of the evidence.
On re-calculation, the compensation for loss of future earning comes to Rs.3,52,800/-.
The Tribunal has assessed only Rs.1,78,200/-.
Hence, a sum of Rs.1,74,600/- is further enhanced.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
6. The appellant has valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.11,000/- and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6524 3 MA-637-2022 months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
7. Accordingly, appeal is disposed of to the extent indicated herein above.
